children: American Integrity Insurance Group's shares rose after the company's third-quarter earnings and revenue came in ahead of analyst expectations.
Shares advanced 8.7% to $30.60 in after-hours trading. The stock closed up 1.4% at $28.14 and has risen 35% through the close this year.
The company reported a profit of $28.4 million, or $1.44 a share, compared with a profit of $13.2 million, or 67 cents a share, a year earlier.
Stripping out certain one-time items, adjusted earnings were also $1.44 a share. Analysts polled by FactSet were expecting 68 cents a share.
Revenue rose 83% to $113.5 million. Analysts were expecting $105.7 million.
Gross premiums written were up 23% to $293.3 million, while net premiums earned soared 95% to $101.2 million.

"Following record voluntary new business production in the second quarter, we sustained that momentum in the third quarter, writing approximately 41,000 voluntary new business policies, an increase of 57% year over year, and an acceleration from the second quarter's year-over-year growth rate," Chief Executive Robert Ritchie said. "We are seeing broad-based growth across our key strategic initiatives and believe we have substantial runway ahead."
